Hi, I'm Luis Ortega. I started Pinwheel in 2010 with one van. Today my wife, Carmen, runs the office, and our 14 techs cover Tracy and the towns around it. I still look over every new install before we call it done.

Every summer on the Tracy street where Luis grew up, kids stuck paper pinwheels in the front lawns, and they spun all evening in the Delta breeze. When he needed a name for the company in 2010, that was the picture in his head.
Every tech learns them on day one.
